d: KPMG has had a presence in Qatar for nearly 47 years. We opened for business in Qatar in 1977 and are now one of the largest and most prestigious professional services firms in the country.

KPMG in Qatar employs over 350 professional staff and partners. We recruit the best and brightest from around the world and currently employ 28 nationalities. For our clients, this means we provide Audit, Tax and Advisory services locally, drawing on the latest thinking and best practice from around the world.

KPMG's Advisory practice is one of the largest Advisory businesses worldwide and the major growth area for our organization. Our services are focused on Finance Function, and we work with clients in identifying and tackling their challenges in Growth, Governance and Performance. Our Advisory teams support businesses as they restructure and expand, whether organically or by acquisition. We help them to become more efficient and provide support as they adapt to the challenges posed by a rapidly changing business environment

The Associate Director (AD) – Cybersecurity (mainly Government Sector) is a senior executive role dedicated to shaping, driving, and delivering robust cybersecurity advisory and large-scale transformation engagements for KPMG clients, primarily within the public sector. This position requires 12+ years of diverse experience spanning strategy, architecture, roadmap development, implementation, and operations, seamlessly blended with deep hands-on technical expertise to address complex, sector-specific security challenges.

Operating as both a seasoned business developer and an authoritative technical leader with a proven track record of building and leading teams in the Qatari market, the AD is directly responsible for shaping and executing the local go-to-market strategy, overseeing the evolution of cybersecurity offerings, and serving as the primary client-facing lead on strategic pursuits and key projects. This includes complete commercial ownership over pipeline development, proposals, and pursuits, ensuring all delivered solutions strictly align with public sector priorities, sector mandates, and the client’s enterprise operating models.
q: Education: Bachelor’s degree in information security, Computer Science, Engineering or a related technical discipline.
12–15+ years of progressive experience in IT services, cybersecurity and technology risk management.

4+ years directly serving government or public sector clients within the GCC, with proven success closing and delivering large-scale security transformations or emblematic client accounts, preferably in Qatar.
Hands-on background in solution architecture and implementation.
Technical Expertise: Architecture-level knowledge of IAM/PAM, Cloud Security, Network Infrastructure, AI Security, Industrial OT/ICS Security, IoT ecosystems and secure IT modernization.

Regulatory Compliance: Understanding of GRC methodologies and international frameworks (ISO 27001, CRISC, NIST), with fluent operational familiarity with Qatar's frameworks (QCSF, NIA, PDPPL and QCB IT Security Standards).
Certifications: At least two active credentials from:
Management & Strategy: CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, CGEIT
Architecture & Cloud: TOGAF, CCSP, Azure/GCP/AWS Certified Solutions Architect
Technical & Tactical: CEH, GIAC or advanced vendor-specific certifications (Palo Alto Networks, Microsoft Security, Google Cloud Security)
Languages: Professional working proficiency in Arabic and English is a must have
Strategic Thinking & Balance: Secures short-term tactical business development wins while architecting long-term technology and capability roadmaps.
Leadership & Ecosystem Influence: Inspires technical confidence across internal delivery teams and sophisticated public sector clients; commands authority without structural friction.
Executive Communication: Elite negotiation and presentation skills, translating granular technical risk metrics into strategic business insights for non-technical government leaders.
Cultural Agility: Nuanced understanding of Qatari business etiquette, regulatory interactions, executive protocol and GCC market dynamics.
Entrepreneurial Mindset & Resilience: Proactive, self-driven operator with high commercial resilience in navigating lengthy public sector procurement cycles and multi-stakeholder approval matrices.
r: Drive the commercial strategy for the government and public sector cybersecurity practice in Qatar to meet or exceed annual pipeline, sales and revenue targets.

Lead the end-to-end capture process for large-scale public sector opportunities, including bid strategy, proposal writing, technical solution scoping, pricing models and oral presentations to C-level evaluation committees.
Identify, qualify and close new business opportunities within Qatari ministries, public authorities, state-owned enterprises and critical infrastructure entities.
Establish, nurture and leverage strategic joint go-to-market alliances with major cybersecurity vendors (OEMs), local distributors and system integrators to enrich KPMG's ecosystem offerings.
Strategic Client Advisory & Subject Matter Prominence
Serve as the primary, high-visibility cybersecurity advisor to senior government officials, CIOs, CISOs and regulatory bodies across the Qatari market.
Advise clients on interpreting and implementing and international compliance frameworks, including QCSF, NIA, PDPPL and QCB mandates.
Elevate KPMG's brand presence in the region through published thought leadership, strategic market deliverables and keynote representation at security conferences.
Translate technical vulnerabilities, threat vectors and architectural risks into clear, actionable, risk-adjusted insights for non-technical public sector executives.
Govern the delivery of multi-disciplinary, multi-phase cybersecurity transformation programs, with accountability for project margins, quality assurance and on-time execution.
Act as the definitive technical authority during initial project phases, architecting solutions across SIEM/SOAR, IAM/PAM, Zero Trust, Cloud/Hybrid Security and OT/IoT infrastructures.
Oversee quality, risk and compliance reviews for all client deliverables, ensuring alignment with government security protocols and contractual obligations.
Act as executive sponsor for marquee accounts, managing stakeholder relationships, mitigating escalations and identifying cross-selling and renewal opportunities.
Practice Innovation, Capability Development & Team Leadership

Monitor global threat landscapes and emerging technologies (AI-driven security, post-quantum computing, advanced threat hunting, managed detection and response) to evolve and scale KPMG's cybersecurity service lines.
Recruit, mentor and retain a high-performing team of cybersecurity consultants and technical architects, fostering a culture of high performance and continuous development.
Track and report KPIs — consultant utilization, pipeline value, win rates and customer satisfaction — to regional leadership.

d: 负责公司在中东国家的本地法律事务，确保公司业务合规运营。
起草、审核、翻译中英文合同、协议及法律文件，协助业务部门处理各类法律问题。
处理日常法务咨询、合规检查、政府问询沟通等事项。
协助建立和完善子公司合规体系、法律风险防控机制，落实总部合规制度政策。与本地法务和全球法务团队协作，确保跨司法管辖区法律框架和合规标准的一致性。
开发、维护外部律师、律所及其他法律服务供应商资源池。
支持公司内部培训、法律宣传及员工合规意识提升。
法律相关专业本科及以上学历。
7年以上涉外业务法务工作经验 ，有跨境法律事务处理背景或有英语国家海外教育经历。
英语流利 ，具备法律文件中英双语起草、翻译和沟通能力。
具备分析能力、解决问题能力以及向非法律人员解释复杂法律问题的能力。
熟悉政府调查流程，有政府沟通能力及政府调查、问询应对经验，能够处理政府合规、调查等相关事务。
良好的沟通协调能力、团队合作精神及跨文化适应能力。
工作细致严谨，责任心强，能承受一定工作压力、在快节奏环境中管理复杂法律项目，乐于接受新鲜事物、迎接挑战。
有互联网、平台、物流、仓储、外卖等行业法务经验者优先。
有科威特或卡塔尔工作经历优先。
具有中国或其他国家法律执业资格优先。

We are looking for an experienced Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations (F&O) HR Techno-Functional Consultant with 5–7 years of hands-on experience in implementing, customizing, configuring, and supporting HR and Payroll modules.

The ideal candidate should have a strong understanding of HR business processes, payroll operations, employee lifecycle management, performance appraisal processes, and the ability to translate business requirements into functional and technical solutions within Dynamics 365 F&O.
q: Understand and configure employee performance management and appraisal processes.
Implement and support performance evaluation cycles, objectives, KPIs, competency assessments, and employee reviews.
Configure appraisal workflows, evaluation criteria, and performance ratings.
Support the integration of performance management processes with broader HR operations.
Conduct business requirement gathering and fit-gap analysis.
Prepare functional documentation, configuration documents, and user guides.
Perform system testing, UAT, and support deployment activities.
Provide end-user training and post-implementation support.
Recommend process improvements and system optimization opportunities.
5–7 years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations.
Strong functional knowledge of HR and Payroll modules.
Proven experience in HR module customizations and enhancements.
Good understanding of HR appraisal and performance management processes.
Experience with workflows, configurations, reports, and system integrations.
Understanding of D365 F&O technical architecture, X++, and data entities.
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.
Ability to work directly with HR stakeholders and translate business requirements into system solutions.
Previous experience implementing HR and Payroll solutions in the UAE or GCC.
Knowledge of UAE/GCC payroll requirements and labor regulations.
r: Configure, implement, and support the HR and Payroll modules in Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O.
Manage core HR functionalities, including employee management, organizational structures, positions, departments, and personnel administration.
Handle payroll configurations, salary structures, allowances, deductions, benefits, and payroll processing.
Understand and support end-to-end HR and payroll business processes.
Analyze business requirements and translate them into functional and technical specifications.
Have hands-on experience with HR module customizations and enhancements in Dynamics 365 F&O.
Work on custom fields, forms, workflows, reports, and system extensions.
Coordinate with technical teams on X++, integrations, data entities, and reporting requirements.
Troubleshoot system issues and provide technical and functional support.
